messages:
Lina: Quick vibe-check: looking for 90 minutes of TV/movie + 25-minute playlist to accompany a rainstorm and leftover takeout. cozy but with a little edge. suggestions?
Marcus: if you want comfy with edge, movie: "Hunt for the Wilderpeople" funny + warm but odd beats up the cozy. playlist: mellow alt -> soft punk-ish -> gentle electronic.
Jo: TV option: 2 eps of "After Life" (Ricky Gervais) hits that melancholy + warmth. add Norah Jones + Low on the playlist.
Priyanka: for a grittier night: watch episode of "Barry" then a 25-min mix of noir jazz + slow synth. pairs weirdly well with noodles.
Eli: spotify mini-mix I made: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/mini-rainy-vibe (25 min). title = "takeout & thunder". threw in Angelo De Augustine and The National.
Samir: snack+soundtrack hack: put on rain sounds at 10% under the playlist to amplify the storm. tiny life upgrade.
Becca: book toss-in: read a short story by Tessa Hadley between courses for an intimate, domestic mood.
Lina: these are great. can someone rec a 90-min film that's a little uncanny but not full horror? want lingering questions, not nightmares.
Marcus: try "The Lobster" odd, dry, leaves you thinking. not scary but uncanny.
Jo: or "Moon" for sci-fi uncanny and a soft score. both under 2 hours.
Priyanka: poll: react with :one: for "The Lobster", :two: for "Moon", :three: for "Hunt for the Wilderpeople".
Eli: :two:. Moon + synth = my pick.
Samir: :one:. oddity wins for me.
Becca: :three: because I need to feel warm.
Lina: tied results but love the spread. I'll run Eli's playlist, make ramen, and watch Moon tonight. report back if I start asking deep questions about existence. :ramen:
Marcus: if you start philosophizing, we will all join you. also GIF of someone dramatically staring out a rainy window -> <GIF: dramatic_stare>
Jo: tiny logistics: if anyone wants the playlist public access, Eli, can you make it collaborative?
Eli: done. made collaborative and pinned link in this thread. blurb: "25 min - rain, noodles, low lights".
Priyanka: splendid. also note: candles = optional but enhance ambiance. non-work hazard disclaimer: don't leave them unattended.
Samir: will add a tiny tip to the pin: damp towel under burner if you're cooking at low light so you don't set off alarms. learned the hard way. :grimacing:
Becca: love a shared ritual. maybe we do a monthly "takeout + watch" thread? tag #late-night-rituals?
Lina: yes please. starting now: will post a short review after the movie. thanks all. goodnight and dry toasts. :crescent_moon:
